dslRule:
<!id: junit.assert.assertTrue.identity.to.assert_same>
<!description: Replace JUnit Assert.assertTrue(message, x == y) with Assert.assertSame(message, y, x) for reference equality checks, improving clarity and adhering to JUnit's idiomatic assert methods.>
<!severity: HINT>

;;

commitMessage:
Avoid NPE when annotation.getText() == null

Fixes https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform.text/issues/173
dslRule:
<!id: null-safe-string-compare-gettext>
<!description: Replace String.compareTo() with a null-safe comparison for results of getText() to prevent NullPointerExceptions.>
<!severity: WARNING>

$x.getText().compareTo($y.getText()) :: instanceof($x, "org.eclipse.jface.text.source.Annotation") && instanceof($y, "org.eclipse.jface.text.source.Annotation")
=>
$x.getText() == null ? ($y.getText() == null ? 0 : -1) : ($y.getText() == null ? 1 : $x.getText().compareTo($y.getText()))
;;

commitMessage:
brackets highlighting should not contains code mining text #47

`MatchingCharacterPainter` is using the `StyledText.getTextBounds()`
method to determine the width of the highlight box to draw. This method
calculates width based on runs of text, and thus includes the method
parameter hints in that width.

This change instead moves to using `GC.textExtent()` to determine the
width of text to highlight, ensuring that only the desired character is
highlighted.

commitMessage:
Use a custom ForkJoinWorkerThreadFactory in AsyncCompletionProposalPopup (#185)

* Use a custom ForkJoinWorkerThreadFactory in AsyncCompletionProposalPopup

CompletableFuture.supplyAsync() is using the defaultForkJoinWorkerThreadFactory. In case a SecurityManager is installed, using the defaultForkJoinWorkerThreadFactory would result in worker threads with no permissions, which leads to not content assist in the java editor.

Use a custom ForkJoinWorkerThreadFactory implementation to work around this.

See also:
https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform/issues/294
https://github.com/eclipse-platform/eclipse.platform/pull/295

* Improve comment

Prevent multiple "Press F2 for focus" in Generic Editor

Fixes https://github.com/redhat-developer/eclipseide-jdtls/issues/42

Revert "Use a custom ForkJoinWorkerThreadFactory in AsyncCompletionProposalPopup (#185)"

commitMessage:
Reverts #183, as it causes the PopupVisibleTimer to be kept running when
the last remaining proposal computation finishes.

Instead the tear down is done either when it was not visible (as
before #183) or when it was visible but there is no proposals to show.
dslRule:
/*!
<!id: eclipse.jface.text.async-popup-hide-condition>
<!description: Update the condition for hiding the async completion popup to include checking if proposals are available, aligning with fix for #183 revert.>
<!severity: HINT>
*/
isValid($shell$) && $shell$.isVisible() && $remaining$.get() == 0
=>
isValid($shell$) && (!$shell$.isVisible() || !hasProposals) && $remaining$.get() == 0
;;
summary: Updates a boolean condition in an 'if' statement to incorporate an additional 'OR' clause with a boolean variable.
